outcome: A noninstant spell is castable only in the owner's main phase with an empty stack; an instant is castable whenever the player has priority.
An activated ability is activatable whenever its controller has priority.
A special action is takeable whenever its taker has priority, or only in their main phase with an empty stack, as rule 116 specifies for each action.
note: Restates the timing of the rule 116 special actions; covered by unit 116's scenarios.

outcome: A mana ability can be activated whenever the player has priority or a mana payment is being made.
A triggered ability that triggered during casting or resolution is put on the stack only when a player would next receive priority.
The active player receives priority at the start of a step after turn-based actions and beginning-of-step triggers are put on the stack, except in the untap step.
After a spell or ability resolves, the active player receives priority first.
A player who casts a spell or activates an ability with priority receives priority again before any opponent can respond.
note: Same observability as 117.3b: who holds priority is not a record field, but it decides the stack order.

outcome: When all players pass in succession, the top stack object resolves, or the step ends if the stack is empty.
State-based actions are performed repeatedly, then pending triggers are put on the stack, before a player receives priority.
A spell cast in response to another stack object resolves before it.
